JBL Professional 305P MkII page (read): "Input Connectors: 1 x XLR female, 1 x TRS female, balanced", "Cabinet Dimensions (H x W x D): 298 x 185 x 231 mm (11.75 x 7.3 x 9.9 in)" (the plan keeps 231 mm; 9.9 in would be 251 mm: SIZE CONFLICT inside the page, so the size is an estimate and the device is beta-modelled), "LF Driver 126 mm (5 in)", "HF Driver 25 mm (1 in) soft dome", "Enclosure Finish: Matte black PVC".

JBL 3 Series MkII owner manual (French edition, downloaded and read as text; it covers the 305P MkII): "entrees XLR et 6 mm (1/4 in) TRS symetriques", "Raccordez le cable electrique IEC inclus a chaque enceinte de la Serie 3", universal power supply. Documents the connector set (portsDocumented): balanced XLR in, balanced TRS in, IEC mains inlet.

build params: the Wave 0 spike family (curved-cabinet carrying a near-rectangular monitor: plan radius 8, edge radius 6) with a 118 mm woofer ring at 105 mm and a 28 mm tweeter ring at 258 mm in a 62 mm waveguide dish. Recess positions are estimates. Port and control positions on the rear: no drawing or photo was opened, so every position is a plausible guess (confidence guess).
